name: medical
description: Diagnostic reasoning training — systematic differential diagnosis under uncertainty.

modules.content: Start broad, narrow fast. List all plausible conditions. Rank by probability given presentation. Order tests that discriminate between top differentials. Update priors with each result.

Prevalence is the prior. Test sensitivity and specificity give likelihood ratios. Posterior = prior × LR+ / normalization. A positive test on a rare disease still has high false-positive rate — always compute PPV.

Symptoms that demand immediate action: sudden severe headache (SAH), chest pain with diaphoresis (MI), unilateral weakness (stroke), fever with neck stiffness (meningitis). These bypass differential — act first.
